value: Study participants: 15 Yanomami individuals from Brazil (semi-isolated hunter-gatherers)
Comparison groups: Yanomami from Venezuela (n=8), Matses (n=24), Tunapuco (n=12), US urban individuals (n=44)
Sequencing method: Illumina HiSeq 2500, shotgun metagenomic sequencing
Total reads generated: approximately 219 million reads
Average reads per sample: approximately 14 million reads
Taxonomic classification: Kraken database using bacterial and archaeal genomes from NCBI
Functional classification: SUPER-FOCUS using SEED database gene families
Ethics approval: Oswaldo Cruz Foundation Ethics Committee No. 638/11 and CONEP No. 16907
Sample type: Morning fecal samples collected in sterile containers
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: 15 Yanomami individuals from Brazil; Yanomami Venezuela n=8; Matses n=24; Tunapuco n=12; US n=44; HiSeq 2500; 219 million reads; 14 million reads per sample

host_species.notes: Inferred from study of human populations (Yanomami hunter-gatherers); DNA extraction from human stool samples using human reference genome Hg38 confirms human host
